text.name: Alakazam

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Damage Swap
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to another as long as you don't Knock Out that Pokémon. This power can't be used if Alakazam is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

text.flavor: Psi Pokémon. Length: 4' 11", Weight: 106 lbs. Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000. #65

text.name: Articuno

attacks.name: Freeze Dry
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. If tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: Freeze Pokémon. Length: 5' 7", Weight: 122 lbs. A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains. #144

text.name: Charizard

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Energy Burn
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may turn all Energy attached to Charizard into {Fire} Energy for the rest of the turn. This power can't be used if Charizard is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard or this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Flame Pokémon. Length: 5' 7", Weight: 200 lbs. Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires. #6

text.name: Dark Blastoise

attacks.name: Hydrocannon
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each {Water} Energy attached to Dark Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 40 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Rocket Tackle
attacks.text: Dark Blastoise does 10 damage to itself. Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Dark Blastoise during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

text.flavor: Shellfish Pokémon. Length: 5' 3", Weight: 189 lbs. An aggressive Pokémon that tackles anything it sees. #9

text.name: Dark Dragonite

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Summon Minions
abilities.text: When you play Dark Dragonite from your hand, search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Giant Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Dragon Pokémon. Length: 7' 3", Weight: 463 lbs. Sometimes called “The God of Destruction.” Its wings are able to support it in spite of its massive weight. #149

text.name: Dark Persian

attacks.name: Fascinate
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon. This attack can't be used if your opponent has no Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poison Claws
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: Classy Cat Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 71 lbs. Popular with women because of its beautiful fur. The leader of the Rockets keeps one as a pet. LV. 28 #53

text.name: Dark Raichu

attacks.name: Surprise Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, flip another coin. If the second coin is heads, this attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. If the second coin is tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: Mouse Pokémon. Length: 2' 7", Weight: 66 lbs. Stores up electricity in its body, then suddenly releases it to surprise and shock everyone. LV. 31 #26

text.name: Dark Slowbro

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Reel In
abilities.text: When you play Dark Slowbro from your hand, choose up to 3 Basic Pokémon and/or Evolution cards from your discard pile and put them into your hand.

attacks.name: Fickle Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Hermitcrab Pokémon. Length: 5' 3", Weight: 173 lbs. It loves nothing better than to be left alone, and so sometimes ends up being manipulated by unscrupulous people. LV. 27 #80

text.name: Dark Vaporeon

attacks.name: Whirlpool
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.

text.flavor: Bubble Jet Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 64 lbs. A Pokémon capable of controlling water, so it is capable of creating giant whirlpools. LV. 28 #134

text.name: Flareon

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard 1 {Fire} Energy card attached to Flareon or this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Flame Pokémon. Length: 2' 11", Weight: 55 lbs. When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees. #136

text.name: Gengar

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Curse
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another (even if it would Knock Out the other Pokémon). This power can't be used if Gengar is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Dark Mind
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: Shadow Pokémon. Length: 4' 11", Weight: 89 lbs. Under a full moon, this Pokémon likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright. #94

text.name: Gyarados

attacks.name: Bubblebeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Atrocious Pokémon. Length: 21' 4", Weight: 518 lbs. Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage. #130

text.name: Hitmonlee

attacks.name: Stretch Kick
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon, and this attack does 20 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: Kicking Pokémon. Length: 4' 11", Weight: 110 lbs. When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.

text.name: Jolteon

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Pin Missile
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: Lightning Pokémon. Length: 2' 7", Weight: 54 lbs. It accumulates negative ions from the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts. #135

text.name: Machamp

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Strikes Back
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent's attack damages Machamp (even if Machamp is Knocked Out), this power does 10 damage to the attacking Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power can't be used if Machamp is already affected by a Special Condition when your opponent attacks.

text.flavor: Superpower Pokémon. Length: 5' 3", Weight: 287 lbs. Using its amazing muscles, it throws powerful punches that can knock its victim clear over the horizon. #68

text.name: Muk

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Toxic Gas
abilities.text: Ignore all Pokémon Powers other than Toxic Gases. This power stops working while Muk is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Sludge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: Sludge Pokémon. Length: 3' 11", Weight: 66 lbs. Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison. #89

text.name: Ninetales

attacks.name: Lure
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard 1 {Fire} Energy card attached to Ninetales or this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Fox Pokémon. Length: 3' 7", Weight: 44 lbs. Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse. #38

text.name: Venusaur

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Energy Trans
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may take 1 {Grass} Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon and attach it to a different one. This power can't be used if Venusaur is affected by a Special Condition.

text.flavor: Seed Pokémon. Length: 6' 7", Weight: 221 lbs. This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight. #3

text.name: Zapdos

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Zapdos does 30 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy cards attached to Zapdos or this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Electric Pokémon. Length: 5' 3", Weight: 116 lbs. A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts. #145

text.name: Beedrill

attacks.name: Twineedle
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: Poison Bee Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 65 lbs. Flies at high speed and attacks using the large, venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail. #15

text.name: Butterfree

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Remove a number of damage counters from Butterfree equal to half the damage done to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Butterfree has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

text.flavor: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

text.name: Electrode

attacks.name: Chain Lightning
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon isn't Colorless, this attack does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon of the same type as the Defending Pokémon (including your own). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: Ball Pokémon. Length: 3' 11", Weight: 147 lbs. It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

text.name: Exeggutor

attacks.name: Teleport
attacks.text: Switch Exeggutor with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Big Eggsplosion
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy attached to Exeggutor. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: Coconut Pokémon. Length: 6' 7", Weight: 265 lbs. Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute. #103

text.name: Golem

attacks.name: Selfdestruct
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to each Pokémon on each player's Bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Golem does 100 damage to itself.

text.flavor: Megaton Pokémon. Length: 4' 7", Weight: 662 lbs. Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage. #76

text.name: Hypno

attacks.name: Prophecy
attacks.text: Look at up to 3 cards from the top of either player's deck and rearrange them as you like.

attacks.name: Dark Mind
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: Hypnosis Pokémon. Length: 5' 3", Weight: 167 lbs. When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves such as Hypnosis and Confusion. #97

text.name: Jynx

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Meditate
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: Human Shape Pokémon. Length: 4' 7", Weight: 90 lbs. Merely by meditating, the Pokémon launches a powerful psychic energy attack. #124

text.name: Kabutops

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Remove a number of damage counters from Kabutops equal to half the damage done to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Kabutops has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

text.flavor: Shellfish Pokémon. Length: 4' 3", Weight: 89 lbs. Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids. #141

text.name: Magneton

attacks.name: Sonicboom
attacks.text: Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

attacks.name: Selfdestruct
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to each Pokémon on each player's Bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Magneton does 100 damage to itself.

text.flavor: Magnet Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 132 lbs. Formed by several Magnemites linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up. #82

text.name: Mewtwo

attacks.name: Energy Control
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a basic Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and attach it to another of your opponent's Pokémon of your choice.

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

text.flavor: Genetic Pokémon. Length: 6' 7", Weight: 269 lbs. A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments. #150

text.name: Moltres

attacks.name: Wildfire
attacks.text: You may discard any number of {Fire} Energy cards attached to Moltres when you use this attack. If you do, discard that many cards from the top of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Dive Bomb
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Flame Pokémon. Length: 6' 7", Weight: 132 lbs. Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames. #146

text.name: Nidoking

attacks.name: Thrash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage and Nidoking does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Toxic
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. It now takes 20 Poison damage instead of 10 after each player's turn (even if it was already Poisoned).

text.flavor: Drill Pokémon. Length: 4' 7", Weight: 137 lbs. Uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break its prey's bones. #34

text.name: Nidoqueen

attacks.name: Boyfriends
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each Nidoking you have in play.

text.flavor: Drill Pokémon. Length: 4' 3", Weight: 132 lbs. Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

text.name: Pidgeot

attacks.name: Hurricane
attacks.text: Unless this attack Knocks Out the Defending Pokémon, return the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your opponent's hand.

text.flavor: Bird Pokémon. Length: 4' 11", Weight: 87 lbs. When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp. #18

text.name: Pidgeotto

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Mirror Move
attacks.text: If Pidgeotto was attacked last turn, do the final result of that attack on Pidgeotto to the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: Bird Pokémon. Length: 3' 7", Weight: 66 lbs. Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder. #17

text.name: Rhydon

attacks.name: Ram
attacks.text: Rhydon does 20 damage to itself. Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon. Switch the Pokémon even if Rhydon is Knocked Out.)

text.flavor: Drill Pokémon. Length: 6' 3", Weight: 265 lbs. Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3600 degrees. #112

text.name: Arcanine

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard 1 {Fire} Energy card attached to Arcanine or this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Arcanine does 30 damage to itself.

text.flavor: Legendary Pokémon. Length: 6' 3", Weight: 342 lbs. A Pokémon that has been long admired for its beauty. It runs gracefully, as if on wings. #59

text.name: Charmeleon

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard 1 {Fire} Energy card attached to Charmeleon or this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Flame Pokémon. Length: 3' 7", Weight: 42 lbs. When it swings its burning tail, it raises the temperature to unbearably high levels. #5

text.name: Dark Dragonair

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Evolutionary Light
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for an Evolution card. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Dark Dragonair is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Tail Strike
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.

text.flavor: Dragon Pokémon. Length: 13' 1", Weight: 36 lbs. As is fitting for a legendary Pokémon, it has many strange powers, including the ability to make rain or snow fall. #148

text.name: Dark Wartortle

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Mirror Shell
attacks.text: If an attack does damage to Dark Wartortle during your opponent's next turn (even if Dark Wartortle is Knocked Out), Dark Wartortle does an equal amount of damage to the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: Turtle Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 50 lbs. A Pokémon with a negative attitude, it hides in its shell whenever it's in a bad mood—which is often. #8

text.name: Dewgong

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Sea Lion Pokémon. Length: 5' 7", Weight: 265 lbs. Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters. #87

text.name: Dodrio

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Retreat Aid
abilities.text: As long as Dodrio is Benched, pay {Colorless} less to retreat your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Dodrio.

text.flavor: Triplebird Pokémon. Length: 5' 11", Weight: 188 lbs. Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake. #85

text.name: Fearow

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Fearow.

text.flavor: Beak Pokémon. Length: 3' 11", Weight: 84 lbs. With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest. #22

text.name: Golduck

attacks.name: Psyshock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.

text.flavor: Duck Pokémon. Length: 5' 7", Weight: 169 lbs. Often seen swimming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa. #55

text.name: Graveler

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, whenever 30 or less damage is done to Graveler (after applying Weakness and Resistance), prevent that damage. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

text.flavor: Rock Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 232 lbs. Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction. #75

text.name: Growlithe
text.flavor: Puppy Pokémon. Length: 2' 4", Weight: 42 lbs. Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space. #58

text.name: Haunter

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Transparency
abilities.text: Whenever an attack does anything to Haunter, flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of that attack, including damage, done to Haunter. This power stops working while Haunter is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Nightmare
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

text.flavor: Gas Pokémon. Length: 5' 3", Weight: 0.2 lbs. Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension. #93

text.name: Ivysaur

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: Seed Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 29 lbs. When the bulb on its back grows large, the Pokémon seems to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs. #2

text.name: Kabuto

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Kabuto Armor
abilities.text: Whenever an attack (even your own) does damage to Kabuto (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does only half the damage to Kabuto (rounded down to the nearest 10). (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) This power stops working while Kabuto is affected by a Special Condition.

text.flavor: Shellfish Pokémon. Length: 1' 8", Weight: 25 lbs. A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago. #140

text.name: Kadabra

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard 1 {Psychic} Energy card attached to Kadabra or this attack does nothing. Remove all damage counters from Kadabra.

text.flavor: Psi Pokémon. Length: 4' 3", Weight: 125 lbs. It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches even to those just nearby. #64

text.name: Kakuna

attacks.name: Stiffen
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Kakuna during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: Cocoon Pokémon. Length: 2' 0", Weight: 22 lbs. Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators. #14

text.name: Machoke

attacks.name: Karate Chop
attacks.text: Does 50 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on Machoke.

attacks.name: Submission
attacks.text: Machoke does 20 damage to itself.

text.flavor: Superpower Pokémon. Length: 4' 11", Weight: 155 lbs. Its muscular body is so powerful that it must wear a power-save belt to help regulate its motions. LV. 40 #67

text.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Magikarp.

text.flavor: Fish Pokémon. Length: 2' 11", Weight: 22 lbs. In the distant past, it was stronger than its horribly weak descendants that exist today. LV. 8 #129

text.name: Meowth

attacks.name: Pay Day
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, draw a card.

text.flavor: Scratch Cat Pokémon. Length: 1' 4", Weight: 9 lbs. Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change. LV. 15 #52

text.name: Metapod

attacks.name: Stiffen
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Metapod during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Cocoon Pokémon. Length: 2' 4", Weight: 22 lbs. It is vulnerable to attack because its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body. LV. 21 #11

text.name: Nidorina

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Double Kick
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: Poison Pin Pokémon. Length: 2' 7", Weight: 44 lbs. The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting. LV. 24 #30

text.name: Nidorino

attacks.name: Double Kick
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: Poison Pin Pokémon. Length: 2' 11", Weight: 43 lbs. An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom. LV. 25 #33

text.name: Omanyte

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Clairvoyance
abilities.text: Your opponent plays with his or her hand face up. This power stops working while Omanyte is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each {Water} Energy attached to Omanyte but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

text.flavor: Spiral Pokémon. Length: 1' 4", Weight: 17 lbs. Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils. LV. 19 #138

text.name: Omastar

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each {Water} Energy attached to Omastar but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Spike Cannon
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: Spiral Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 77 lbs. A prehistoric Pokémon that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible for it to catch prey. LV. 32 #139

text.name: Primeape

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Tantrum
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Primeape is now Confused (after doing damage).

text.flavor: Pig Monkey Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 71 lbs. Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until its quarry is caught. LV. 35 #57

text.name: Rapidash

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Rapidash.

text.flavor: Fire Horse Pokémon. Length: 5' 7", Weight: 209 lbs. Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it. LV. 33 #78

text.name: Raticate

attacks.name: Super Fang
attacks.text: Does damage to the Defending Pokémon equal to half the Defending Pokémon's remaining HP (rounded up to the nearest 10).

text.flavor: Rat Pokémon. Length: 2' 4", Weight: 41 lbs. It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It seems to slow down if they are cut off. LV. 41 #20

text.name: Sandslash

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: Mouse Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 65 lbs. Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape. LV. 33 #28

text.name: Seadra

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each {Water} Energy attached to Seadra but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Seadra.

text.flavor: Dragon Pokémon. Length: 3' 1", Weight: 55 lbs. Capable of swimming backward by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail. LV. 23 #117

text.name: Snorlax

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Thick Skinned
abilities.text: Snorlax can't become Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Burned. This power stops working while Snorlax is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

text.name: Tauros

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Rampage
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Tauros. Flip a coin. If tails, Tauros is now Confused (after doing damage).

text.flavor: Wild Bull Pokémon. Length: 4' 7", Weight: 195 lbs. When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails. LV. 32 #128

text.name: Tentacruel

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Jellyfish Sting
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: Jellyfish Pokémon. Length: 5' 3", Weight: 121 lbs. The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey. LV. 21 #73

text.name: Abra

attacks.name: Psyshock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Psi Pokémon. Length: 2' 11", Weight: 43 lbs. Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety. LV. 10 #63

text.name: Bulbasaur

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Unless all damage from this attack is prevented, you may remove 1 damage counter from Bulbasaur.

text.flavor: Seed Pokémon. Length: 2' 4", Weight: 15 lbs. A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. Thus, a plant sprouted and now grows with this Pokémon. LV. 13 #1

text.name: Caterpie

attacks.name: String Shot
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Worm Pokémon. Length: 1' 0", Weight: 6 lbs. Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls. LV. 13 #10

text.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard 1 {Fire} Energy card attached to Charmander or this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Lizard Pokémon. Length: 2' 0", Weight: 19 lbs. Obviously prefers hot places. If it gets caught in the rain, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail. LV. 10 #4

text.name: Doduo

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: Twin Bird Pokémon. Length: 4' 7", Weight: 86 lbs. A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints. LV. 10 #84

text.name: Dratini
text.flavor: Dragon Pokémon. Length: 5' 11", Weight: 7 lbs. Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater. LV. 10 #147

text.name: Drowzee

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Long-Distance Hypnosis
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep; if tails, your Active Pokémon is now Asleep. The power can't be used if Drowzee is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Nightmare
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

text.flavor: Hypnosis Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 71 lbs. Not popular with girls because of its attitude. Can often be heard muttering to itself in a low voice. LV. 10 #96

text.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Tail Wag
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack Eevee during your opponent's next turn. (Benching either Pokémon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

text.flavor: Evolution Pokémon. Length: 1' 0", Weight: 14 lbs. Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from elemental stones. LV. 12 #133

text.name: Exeggcute

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Unless all damage from this attack is prevented, you may remove 1 damage counter from Exeggcute.

text.flavor: Egg Pokémon. Length: 1' 4", Weight: 6 lbs. Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms. LV. 14 #102

text.name: Gastly

attacks.name: Lick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Energy Conversion
attacks.text: Put up to 2 Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand. Gastly does 10 damage to itself.

text.flavor: Gas Pokémon. Length: 4' 3", Weight: 0.2 lbs. A mysterious Pokémon. Some say it is a lifeform from another dimension, while others believe it is formed from smog. LV. 17 #92

text.name: Geodude

attacks.name: Stone Barrage
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: Rock Pokémon. Length: 1' 4", Weight: 44 lbs. Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them. LV. 16 #74

text.name: Grimer

attacks.name: Nasty Goo
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Minimize
attacks.text: All damage done by attacks to Grimer during your opponent's next turn is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.flavor: Sludge Pokémon. Length: 2' 11", Weight: 66 lbs. Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories. LV. 17 #88

text.name: Machop
text.flavor: Superpower Pokémon. Length: 2' 7", Weight: 43 lbs. It's said that not even pro wrestlers can take down a Machop. LV. 24 #66

text.name: Magnemite

attacks.name: Thunder Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Selfdestruct
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each Pokémon on each player's Bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Magnemite does 40 damage to itself.

text.flavor: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses attacks like Thunder Wave.

text.name: Mankey

attacks.name: Mischief
attacks.text: Shuffle your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Anger
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.

text.flavor: Pig Monkey Pokémon. Length: 1' 8", Weight: 62 lbs. Normally friendly, it quickly becomes angry if it doesn't get what it wants. LV. 14 #56

text.name: Nidoran ♀

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon named Nidoran ♀ or Nidoran ♂ and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)

text.flavor: Although small, its venomous barbs make this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

text.name: Nidoran ♂

attacks.name: Horn Hazard
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Poison Pin Pokémon. Length: 1' 4", Weight: 15 lbs. Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom. LV. 20 #32

text.name: Onix

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, whenever 30 or less damage is done to Onix (after applying Weakness and Resistance), prevent that damage. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

text.flavor: Rock Snake Pokémon. Length: 28' 10", Weight: 463 lbs. As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black. LV. 12 #95

text.name: Pidgey

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

text.flavor: Tiny Bird Pokémon. Length: 1' 0", Weight: 4 lbs. A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand. LV. 8 #16

text.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Spark
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: Mouse Pokémon. Length: 1' 4", Weight: 13 lbs. When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms. LV. 14 #25

text.name: Ponyta
text.flavor: Fire Horse Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 66 lbs. Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything flat in moments. LV. 10 #77

text.name: Psyduck

attacks.name: Dizziness
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each {Water} Energy attached to Psyduck but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

text.flavor: Duck Pokémon. Length: 2' 7", Weight: 43 lbs. It is often seen holding its head in its paws, as if it were suffering from a headache. LV. 16 #54

text.name: Rattata
text.flavor: Rat Pokémon. Length: 1' 0", Weight: 8 lbs. Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places. LV. 9 #19

text.name: Rhyhorn

attacks.name: Leer
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn. (Benching either Pokémon ends this effect.)

text.flavor: Spikes Pokémon. Length: 3' 3", Weight: 254 lbs. Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying. LV. 18 #111

text.name: Sandshrew

attacks.name: Sand-attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Mouse Pokémon. Length: 2' 0", Weight: 26 lbs. Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food. LV. 12 #27

text.name: Seel
text.flavor: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. This horn is used for bashing through thick ice.

text.name: Slowpoke

attacks.name: Spacing Out
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove a damage counter from Slowpoke. This attack can't be used if Slowpoke has no damage counters on it.

attacks.name: Scavenge
attacks.text: Discard 1 {Psychic} Energy card attached to Slowpoke in order to use this attack. Put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

text.flavor: Dopey Pokémon. Length: 3' 11", Weight: 79 lbs. Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack. LV. 18 #79

text.name: Spearow

attacks.name: Mirror Move
attacks.text: If Spearow was attacked last turn, do the final result of that attack on Spearow to the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: Tiny Bird Pokémon. Length: 1' 0", Weight: 4 lbs. Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne. LV. 13 #21

text.name: Squirtle

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Squirtle during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

text.flavor: Tiny Turtle Pokémon. Length: 1' 8", Weight: 20 lbs. After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth. LV. 8 #7

text.name: Tentacool

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Cowardice
abilities.text: At any time during your turn (before your attack), you may return Tentacool to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to Tentacool.) This power can't be used the turn you put Tentacool into play or if Tentacool is affected by a Special Condition.

text.flavor: Jellyfish Pokémon. Length: 2' 11", Weight: 100 lbs. Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid. LV. 10 #72

text.name: Voltorb
text.flavor: Ball Pokémon. Length: 1' 8", Weight: 23 lbs. Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people. LV. 10 #100

text.name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

text.flavor: Fox Pokémon. Length: 2' 0", Weight: 22 lbs. At the time of birth, it has just one tail. Its tail splits from the tip as it grows older. LV. 11 #37

text.name: Weedle

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: Hairy Bug Pokémon. Length: 1' 0", Weight: 7 lbs. Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp, venomous stinger on its head. LV. 12 #13

text.name: Full Heal Energy
effect: If you play this card from your hand, the Pokémon you attach it to is no longer affected by a Special Condition. Full Heal Energy provides {Colorless} energy.
(Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

text.name: Potion Energy
effect: If you play this card from your hand, remove 1 damage counter from the Pokémon you attach it to, if it has any. Potion Energy provides {Colorless} energy.
(Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

text.name: Pokémon Breeder
effect: Put a Stage 2 Evolution card from your hand on the matching Basic Pokémon. You can play this card only when you would be allowed to evolve that Pokémon anyway.

text.name: Pokémon Trader
effect: Trade 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards in your hand for 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards from your deck. Show both cards to your opponent. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.name: Scoop Up
effect: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play and return its Basic Pokémon card to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)

text.name: The Boss’s Way
effect: Search your deck for an Evolution card with Dark in its name. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.name: Challenge!
effect: Ask your opponent if he or she accepts your challenge. If your opponent declines (or if both Benches are full), draw 2 cards. If your opponent accepts, each of you searches your decks for any number of Basic Pokémon cards and puts them face down onto your Benches. (A player can't do this if his or her Bench is full.) When you both have finished, shuffle your decks and turn those cards face up.

text.name: Energy Retrieval
effect: Trade 1 of the other cards in your hand for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile.

text.name: Mysterious Fossil
effect: Play Mysterious Fossil as if it were a Basic Pokémon. While in play, Mysterious Fossil counts as a Pokémon (instead of a Trainer card). Mysterious Fossil has no attacks, can't retreat, and can't be affected by Special Conditions. If Mysterious Fossil is Knocked Out, it doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon. (Discard it anyway.) At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Mysterious Fossil from play. You can put Pokémon that evolve from Mysterious Fossil on this card.

text.name: Potion
effect: Remove up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

text.name: Charizard

abilities.label: Pokémon Power
abilities.name: Energy Burn
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may turn all Energy attached to Charizard into {Fire} Energy for the rest of the turn. This power can't be used if Charizard is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard or this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Flame Pokémon. Length: 5' 7", Weight: 200 lbs. Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires. LV. 76 #6

text.name: Dark Blastoise

attacks.name: Hydrocannon
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each {Water} Energy attached to Dark Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 40 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Rocket Tackle
attacks.text: Dark Blastoise does 10 damage to itself. Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Dark Blastoise during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

text.flavor: Shellfish Pokémon. Length: 5' 3", Weight: 189 lbs. An aggressive Pokémon that tackles anything it sees. LV. 28 #9

text.name: Dark Raichu

attacks.name: Surprise Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, flip another coin. If the second coin is heads, this attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. If the second coin is tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: Stirs up electricity in its body, then suddenly releases it to surprise and shock everyone.

text.name: Mewtwo

attacks.name: Energy Control
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a basic Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and attach it to another of your opponent's Pokémon of your choice.

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

text.flavor: Genetic Pokémon. Length: 6' 7", Weight: 269 lbs. A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments. LV. 30 #150
